name: Tinker Spider Bomb and Firepot Drone carry their creator like a native summon (#12782)
contract: #12782, #10267, #10271, #9792: Firepot Drone and Spider Bomb damage lands but never shows in Details,
Recount or floating combat text. #9511 gave the devices their owner (UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY), which did not
change the meters. A native summon also records the creator (UNIT_FIELD_CREATEDBY) and the summoning spell,
and the summon is logged to the client as a SPELL_SUMMON combat log event, which is how meters tie a
guardian's damage to its owner. The shared Tinker Summon() helper now does all three, as the Knight of
Xoroth summons do. The scenario observes the creator link: each built device must be counted by a
creator-only lookup for the Tinker. The combat log event and the client display are client-side and are
